tools.name: airport_status
tools.description: Current FAA status for one US airport: normal, advisory or disrupted, max severity (0-5) and each active event (ground stop, ground delay program with average/max delay, arrival/departure delays, closure). Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

tools.name: us_airport_disruptions
tools.description: Every current FAA disruption in US airspace (ground stops, ground delay programs, delays, closures) ranked by severity. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

tools.name: tfr_corridor
tools.description: Active and upcoming US Temporary Flight Restrictions whose area intersects a bounding box, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection: polygon per restricted area with altitude band (feet + AGL/MSL), effective time and valid_until, NOTAM id, type and facility. Fuses the FAA TFR list with each NOTAM's boundary g

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "airport_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
